situation: You registered and paid for an evening course at a local community college. The course starts next month, but your work schedule has changed and you can no longer attend at that time.
task: Write an email to the college registration office in about 150-200 words. You are asking for help with your registration.
points: Explain which course you registered for and why you cannot attend.
Ask whether you can move to a class at a different time.
Ask about a refund if a change is not possible.
sample:
Dear Registration Office,

My name is Andre Silva, and my student number is 204418. I am writing to ask for your help with a course I registered for last month.

I signed up for Introduction to Accounting, which takes place on Tuesday and Thursday evenings from 6:00 to 9:00, starting on September 9. I paid the full fee of $480 online. Unfortunately, my employer has just changed my schedule, and from next month I will be working until 8:00 p.m. on weekdays. As a result, I will not be able to attend this class.

I am still very interested in the course, as I need it for a promotion at work. Is the same course offered on Saturdays or online? If so, I would be grateful if you could transfer my registration to that class.

If no other time is available, could you please tell me whether I can receive a refund, and what I need to do to request one? I can provide a letter from my employer if necessary.

Thank you for your help.

Sincerely,

Andre Silva
